title.value: INVESTIGATING MULTI-TASK PRETRAINING AND GENERALIZATION IN REINFORCEMENT LEARNING
title.justification: The title exactly matches the provided paper and reflects the primary focus of the research discussed.
title.quote: I NVESTIGATING MULTI - TASK PRETRAINING AND GENERALIZATION IN REINFORCEMENT LEARNING

extractions.description: This paper explores the performance of multi-task pretraining and generalization in reinforcement learning, particularly using the IMPALA algorithm. The authors focus on Atari game variants as benchmarks and examine the impact of pretraining on multiple tasks and its effect on generalization to unseen tasks. The paper finds that agents trained with more variations generalize better and explores the benefits of larger network architectures in this context.
